intentions.title: One login for all your Barkparks: a control-plane User/Team/Membership identity layer distinct from api/'s per-tenant Workspace principals
intentions.evidence: user.ex moduledoc: 'the principal behind one login for all your Barkparks'; team.ex is explicitly 'the Cloud analogue of api/'s Barkpark.Tenancy.Workspace'; team_membership.ex is 'the Cloud mirror of api/'s Barkpark.Tenancy.Membership'; authz.ex is 'the Cloud mirror of api/'s Barkpark.Tenancy.Auth'

intentions.title: Ship email+password auth with a full lifecycle (verify, change-email, password reset) plus passwordless OAuth (GitHub/Google) without ever using email as the account-linking key
intentions.evidence: user.ex registration_changeset/confirm_changeset/email_change_changeset/apply_email_change_changeset/oauth_changeset; external_identity.ex binds on (provider, provider_uid) not email, explicitly to avoid 'Coolify's email-only account-reconstruction footgun' / account-takeover via a second IdP

intentions.title: Ship per-user TOTP two-factor authentication with encrypted-at-rest secrets, single-use replay-guarded codes, and recovery codes
intentions.evidence: two_factor.ex (NimbleTOTP, Vault.encrypt for secret + codes, matching_step/3 replay guard via two_factor_last_step); user.ex two_factor_enroll/confirm/disable/codes changesets; two_factor_rate_limiter.ex

intentions.title: Issue and govern bearer credentials for both interactive sessions and programmatic Personal Access Tokens from a single hash-at-rest token table, with a bounded, server-enforced PAT ability vocabulary (read/write/deploy/root)
intentions.evidence: user_token.ex: dual context session/pat, SHA-256 token_hash never plaintext, revoked_at/expires_at kill switches, normalize_abilities/1 enforcing root/deploy exclusivity server-side 'mirroring Coolify's ApiTokens.updatedPermissions ... THIS is the authority'

intentions.title: Enforce role-ranked, per-team authorization (member < admin < owner) as the single source of truth for every money- and infra-destructive action, with total (never-raising) policy evaluation and anti-escalation grant limits
intentions.evidence: authz.ex authorize/3 policy table (read=member, launch/delete_barkpark/connect_provider/manage_members=admin, billing/delete_team=owner), 'TOTAL ... never raises', can_grant?/3 blocks an admin from minting a role at or above their own rank

intentions.title: Maintain an append-only, tamper-proof audit trail of every security/account-relevant action per team, enforced at the database level not just the ORM
intentions.evidence: audit_event.ex: no updated_at field, closed @actions vocabulary via validate_inclusion, moduledoc states 'the migration installs a BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger so a raw SQL mutation is rejected at the DB, not just by Ecto'; actor_user_id nilified (not cascaded) on account deletion

intentions.title: Drive durable, resumable team onboarding (subscription/instance/published_doc checklist) and a one-trial-per-team-ever entitlement ledger that survives subscription teardown
intentions.evidence: team.ex onboarding_state/onboarding_completed_at + onboarding_changeset (separate from the registration changeset so it can't trip name/slug validation); trial_started_at/trial_ends_at/trial_notice_3d_sent_at/trial_notice_1d_sent_at columns described as 'the DURABLE one-trial-per-team-EVER ledger' with an atomic claim guard
